dateAssessment: Working dates use YAML’s November 6–13, 1748 and the dated [[Session 64 (DuFr)]] timeline: the expedition on November 6, training November 7–12, and Kenzo’s departure on November 13. The time extraction remains **compatible**: the transcript gives a short rest, about an hour of travel and uncounted days of training, not seven independently counted date boundaries. The watch carries from **session 059**, whose late-afternoon approach (u0925–u0927) ends with Somi-nai swimming away (u2059–u2062); session 064 u0015–u0025 and u0051–u0067 resume that same encounter moments later. This is the Kenzo/Izzarak/Enari handoff, independent of the intervening groups’ numeric session order. Afternoon → dusk is estimated from that late-afternoon anchor plus the one-hour rest; the next hour places the basin expedition in dusk. Dream entries and returns use Kenzo’s adventure clock; the souls’ lives and Grash’s year-old attack receive no historical date or added elapsed days. The portal’s last-light operating condition does not date Kenzo’s Feywild arrival, whose watch remains open.

watches.summary: Late-afternoon handoff from session 059; Kenzo and Enari complete a conventional one-hour short rest.
An hour of travel follows the rest; the continuous basin expedition and Kenzo’s dream entries carry into dusk.
Days pass in Kenzo’s training; the dated campaign record assigns November 7–12 before his November 13 departure.
